notes: RETRIEVED VIA ARCHIVE: asus.com has RETIRED this product page - the live global, US, CA, CH-EN and ME-EN techspec URLs all 301-redirect to the generic Zenbook landing page. The dimensions, weight, display and ports above were read from a web.archive.org snapshot of the MANUFACTURER url https://www.asus.com/laptops/for-home/zenbook/zenbook-17-fold-oled-ux9702/techspec/ (snapshot 2024-02-21, cross-checked against snapshots 2022-12-06 and 2022-12-29 which carry identical values), which SPEC treats as primary; retrieved date is today per SPEC. NOTE WebFetch cannot reach web.archive.org at all - the snapshots were pulled with the curl fallback. ONE PANEL THAT FOLDS - single display, role primary. AXIS MAPPING: ASUS publishes ONE dimension row, 'Dimensions (W x D x H)' = 37.85 x 28.76 x 0.87 ~ 1.29 cm, and it is the UNFOLDED state - 378.5 x 287.6 mm comfortably contains the 351.5 x 263.7 mm unfolded active area and could not contain it when folded. So manufacturer WIDTH 378.5 -> open.width, manufacturer DEPTH 287.6 -> open.height, manufacturer HEIGHT/thickness -> open.depth. cm -> mm x10. dimensions_mm.closed IS ENTIRELY NULL: ASUS publishes no folded dimension for this machine anywhere on its tech-spec page or in either press release - the only folded description ASUS gives is the qualitative 'smaller than a sheet of photocopier paper'. Halving the unfolded width would be an inference, so it was not done. open.depth IS ALSO NULL: ASUS gives a RANGE, '0.87 ~ 1.29 cm' (8.7 ~ 12.9 mm), and never states what the two ends correspond to - unlike the Zenbook Duo, where an ASUS press release explicitly pins the low end to 'without Bluetooth keyboard'. No such disambiguation exists here, a range cannot be stored in a scalar field, and picking either end would be a guess, so the field is null and the verbatim range is recorded in this note. FOLDED GEOMETRY (qualitative, from the ASUS press release, recorded here not as fields): the 4:3 17.3in panel 'folds in the middle to create two seamless 3:2 12.5-inch 1920 by 1280 displays'. mass_g 1500 = 1.50 kg x 1000; ASUS's without-keyboard figure - the press release states 'weighs just 1.5 kg without the keyboard, or 1.8 kg with it'. active_area_mm derived from sourced diagonal + sourced resolution assuming square pixels: 2560x1920 is exactly 4:3, matching the stated aspect, so w = 17.3 x 2560 / 3200 x 25.4 = 351.5 mm and h = 17.3 x 1920 / 3200 x 25.4 = 263.7 mm. Panel labelled 'FOLED' by ASUS; recorded as OLED. hinge.axis 'long' read from the fold-in-the-middle geometry ASUS describes. free_stop null - not documented; ASUS rates the hinge for 30,000+ open-close cycles and the machine to MIL-STD-810H. PORTS: 2x Thunderbolt 4 (recorded as usb_c) plus a 3.5mm combo jack; positions null. materials.* ALL NULL: ASUS's tech-spec page has no materials row, and although the launch press release mentions a dark green faux-leather cover, the same release also describes a 'faux leather kickstand' on the detachable keyboard, so it is not certain the material statement describes the laptop chassis rather than the keyboard accessory - left null rather than guessed. status 'partial' solely because closed dimensions are unavailable from ASUS. released null - ASUS says only 'globally during Q4 2022'.
